name: Mell
source:
An exiled princess of Genomland. Ruka saved her from pursuit by dangerous assassins.

With the heat off her for the moment, she has been working at the NPA's cafeteria to make a living and enjoy the protection afforded by the agency's walls.

A sweet and earnest girl by nature, she has both the older lunch ladies and the cafeteria's clientele wrapped neatly around her finger. She is oblivious to the workings of society but is eager to learn.

[Edited from [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/1819160]Steam[/url]]
